_comment: The schema pack: shape as data. A kind states what exists and what it needs known — never how to read a document, never a word that classifies raw text. Every entry is jurisdiction-tagged from the first line, because a pack written for one country and internationalised afterwards has invisible omissions. Impersonal by construction: no vault data, no personal value, shareable and reviewable in one sitting.

answer_types.money: an amount the person states, in a currency
answer_types.date: a calendar date the person states
answer_types.choice: one of an enumerated set this question names
answer_types.label: the person's own word for something — a nickname, never an issued identifier
answer_types.institution: the public name of a company that issued or holds the thing
answer_types.link: another account, chosen among those that exist or opened by its own interview
